request.description: Anonymous. Returns Published screens only, ordered by displayOrder. Empty list is 200 [].

Anonymous. Returns published visible sections ordered by displayOrder, virtual stats key excluded. Every one of the 11 stored types returns the same bilingual envelope (arabicTitle/englishTitle plus optional arabicBody/englishBody), the raw contentJson exactly as stored, imagePath, displayOrder, and testimonials/faqs (resolved live for the testimonials and faq types, null for every other type). Empty list is 200 [].

Anonymous. Live counters computed per request from real rows, never stored or hard-coded: familiesCount (excluding soft-deleted), medicalCaregiversCount and companionCaregiversCount (Active rows by type), approvedFacilitiesCount (Approved facility rows, 0 when there are none) and totalCaregiversCount (the sum). The client may cache these reads behind a 60-second ISR window; there is no revalidation webhook.

item.name: Submit landing contact form (shared support flow)

request.description: Authenticated app JWT. The landing contact-form section configures fields; submission enters the real shared support flow (no separate landing ticket table). Subject 3-150 chars, message 10-2000 chars. Success 200 with ticket receipt.

body.raw:
{
  "name": "Nour Hassan",
  "company": "Hassani Care",
  "phone": "+20 100 123 4567",
  "companyType": "Care home",
  "city": "القاهرة",
  "email": "nour@example.com",
  "subject": "Partnership",
  "message": "We would like to discuss a partnership."
}

request.description: Anonymous - no Authorization header. Partner/business contact whose destination is the existing admin support inbox. No account is created and no identity is faked: the submitted name/company/phone/companyType/city/email/subject/message are stored as request data. company is the company NAME, kept separate from companyType (optional FREE TEXT <=100 chars - the select options are frontend-owned, no enum). phone is optional (<=32 chars, digits with an optional leading + and the separators space/()/-.); city is optional free text <=120 chars. All three are omitted-or-blank -> null and are part of the idempotency content. The Idempotency-Key header is REQUIRED: the same key with the same content returns the same receipt, the same key with different content returns 409 Identity.PartnerContact.IdempotencyConflict, and too many submissions from one caller answer 429 Identity.PartnerContact.RateLimited with a Retry-After header. A validation failure returns 400 (Api.Validation.Failed, or Identity.PartnerContact.Invalid from the domain rules). Success 200 with { contactId, submittedOnUtc }.

item.name: Get public platform status

request.description: Anonymous. Returns the sanitized public platform status: state (1 Operational, 2 Maintenance), the published bilingual maintenance message, the currently available supported payment methods (1 Card, 2 Wallet), and subscriptionCardEnrollmentAvailable (whether Card is usable for a subscription initial enrollment). ApplePay is never advertised. Fails closed with 503 Platform.ControlStateUnavailable when the platform controls cannot be read.

item.description: Read before starting a new booking or payment. Advisory for the UI only: the server enforces the same rules and refuses gated routes with 503 Platform.Maintenance or 400 Platform.PaymentMethodUnavailable.

request.description: Anonymous. Returns the published navbar links and the SEO defaults: { navbarLinks, seo }. navbarLinks is the authored list in the authored order (the navbar order) and each link carries { key, arabicLabel, englishLabel, url }. seo is null when no SEO default was authored and each of its members is null when that member was not authored. Before anything is authored the read is honest: 200 with navbarLinks [] and seo null. The read exposes only the published content - no identity, timestamps or authoring metadata.

Anonymous - no Authorization header, no token is read. Serves the current Published Privacy Policy or Terms & Conditions authored for the anonymous Public audience (LegalAudience = 0), in the same LegalDocumentResponse shape as the signed-in app read /api/v1/legal/* (bilingual ordered sections; audience 0, status 2). {documentType} binds from the route as a LegalDocumentType: 1 or PrivacyPolicy, 2 or TermsAndConditions (numeric or enum name, case-insensitive). Only the current Published Public version is served - no drafts, no archived versions, and no fallback to a different audience (a published Family document does not satisfy a public read). Help Center is NOT public: it stays on the authenticated GET /api/v1/help-center. Examples: GET {{baseUrl}}/api/v1/public/legal/PrivacyPolicy and GET {{baseUrl}}/api/v1/public/legal/2. Success 200 with the document. Malformed or undefined {documentType} (0, 3, 9, abc, a comma list) -> 400 Cms.Content.InvalidDocumentType. No current Published Public version for the requested type -> 404 Cms.Legal.NotPublished.
